description: Every change in the copied text files. 'files' lists each replacement of a local path prefix. 'redactions' lists each direct quote of private chat that was replaced by '[redacted: private chat]'. No other text and no number was changed: the build compared every number in each file before and after the change.
private_prefix: <HOME> stands for the home folder of the original Linux account. Its value is withheld. With the value, the log rebuilds each original file exactly (integrity/verify.py --home).
position_convention: line and col are 1-based. col counts characters. col_copy is the position of the replacement text in the copy.

rules.meaning: Old project root with a slash. Replaced by nothing, so the path becomes relative to records/.
Old project root without a slash. Replaced by '.', the project root (records/).
Other paths in the home folder (for example the Hugging Face cache). The home folder becomes <local>.
The home folder without a slash. Replaced by <local>.

redaction_rule.scope: Direct quotes of private chat messages (text in quotation marks that reproduces the words of a chat message). The quotation marks are part of the removed passage. Neutral reports of an authorization, for example 'The user authorized this fresh bridge run', are not quotes and are not redacted.
